correctness.rationale: PASS: For root query (a,b) in rank-two shift graph, all positively answering centers partition into A={(i,a):i<a} and B={(b,j):j>b}; any further query selects a whole arm, singleton, none, or both, so the positive version space has Ldim<=2, hence universal <=3 even for the infinite graph. Small n bound uses |positive fiber|<=n-2, and explicit complete depth-two/depth-three trees attain thresholds n=4 and n=6. Independent minimax ranks for n=2..7 are 0,1,2,2,3,3. The proof is global; finite computations are corroborating.
